question: Choose the correct **one-word substitute** for: 'Something that is impossible to be read'.
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. Illegible .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **'Illegible'** refers to something that cannot be read or deciphered due to poor handwriting, faded ink, or similar reasons.
 
• The other options do not match the meaning:
 
 
• **Decipherable:** Means something that can be decoded or understood.
 
• **Invisible:** Refers to something that cannot be seen.
 
• **Unutterable:** Refers to something that cannot be spoken or expressed.
 

Correct sentence: *Something that is impossible to be read is called **Illegible**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Illegible:** Commonly used to describe poor handwriting or any text that cannot be interpreted due to clarity issues.
 
• **Synonyms:** Unreadable, indecipherable.
 
• **Antonyms:** Legible, readable.
